episodes.title: We Is Us
episodes.summary: An astronomer's discovery turns the planet upside down. Carol Sturka, a curmudgeonly novelist, is terrified by this strange new world.

episodes.title: Pirate Lady
episodes.summary: A curiously familiar face introduces Carol to the bizarre new normal. A gathering in Europe brings strangers together…and causes friction.

episodes.title: Grenade
episodes.summary: The World just wants to help—which infuriates Carol. A heart-to-heart conversation ends with a bang.

episodes.title: Please, Carol
episodes.summary: Carol tests the boundaries of this weirdly honest world at the expense of her ego. Far away, a resolute individual learns he's not alone.

episodes.title: Got Milk
episodes.summary: Carol doubles down on her investigation—loneliness be damned. Meanwhile, howls in the night reveal a new source of danger.

episodes.title: HDP
episodes.summary: Carol shares a horrific discovery and learns new truths in the process. Mr. Diabaté lives life to the fullest in Sin City.

episodes.title: The Gap
episodes.summary: Manousos begins a dangerous trek to meet Carol. Returning home from Las Vegas, Carol gets creative with her rebellion.

episodes.title: Charm Offensive
episodes.summary: Carol takes a different tack with The Others and discovers more than she anticipated. Manousos awakens in unfamiliar surroundings.

episodes.title: La Chica o El Mundo
episodes.summary: Season finale. Manousos arrives in Albuquerque and complications ensue. Carol visits the last best place on Earth.
